info.title: Spotify Web API
info.description: Search tracks, albums, artists. Get artist info and recommendations. Requires an OAuth 2.0 access token (Bearer). Get one at: https://accounts.spotify.com/api/token using Client Credentials flow.

get.description: Search for tracks, albums, artists, playlists, or podcasts. Returns paginated results.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of item types to search: track, album, artist, playlist, show, episode.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results per type (1-50, default 20).

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter results by market availability. E.g. 'US', 'GB'.

get.description: Returns full artist info: name, genres, popularity score (0-100), follower count, and images.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Spotify artist ID (e.g. '0OdUWJ0sBjDrqHygGUXeCF' for Band of Horses).

get.description: Returns the top 10 tracks for an artist in a given market.

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for track availability. E.g. 'US'.

get.description: Returns track info: name, artists, album, duration, popularity, preview URL, and Spotify link.
Returns up to 100 track recommendations based on seed artists, tracks, or genres. Use at least one seed.

parameters.name: seed_artists
parameters.description: Comma-separated Spotify artist IDs (up to 5 total seeds across all three seed types).

parameters.name: seed_tracks
parameters.description: Comma-separated Spotify track IDs (up to 5 total seeds).

parameters.name: seed_genres
parameters.description: Comma-separated genre names. E.g. 'pop,indie,rock'. See /v1/recommendations/available-genre-seeds for full list.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of recommendations to return (1-100, default 20).

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for track availability.

parameters.name: target_energy
parameters.description: Target energy value (0.0-1.0). Higher = more energetic tracks.

parameters.name: target_valence
parameters.description: Target valence/mood value (0.0-1.0). Higher = happier, more positive tracks.

parameters.name: target_danceability
parameters.description: Target danceability value (0.0-1.0). Higher = more danceable.

get.summary: Get available genre seeds for recommendations
get.description: Returns the list of available genres that can be used as seed values for the recommendations endpoint.

200.description: List of available genre seed strings
